target: मेरे बड़े भाई हमेशा मेरा ख़याल रखते हैं।
english: My elder brother always looks after me.
reason: UNNATURAL — bare "बड़े भाई साहब" with no possessive reads like a literary/textbook title rather than how someone actually talks about their own brother; rewrite keeps the same habitual present + honorific plural agreement.

target: कोई बात नहीं आकाश, अगली बार हो जाएगा।
english: No problem Akash, it'll work out next time.
reason: UNNATURAL — "अगली बार अच्छा करना" is translationese for "do better next time" and lands as a mild lecture; "अगली बार हो जाएगा" is what a native actually says after "कोई बात नहीं", same discourse-marker point.

target: मैंने थाने में चोरी की शिकायत लिखवा दी।
english: I got a theft complaint filed at the police station.
reason: OFFICIALESE — "रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराई" with no subject reads like a police bulletin; everyday speech uses "शिकायत लिखवाना" with an explicit ने-subject, which also keeps the perfective/ergative point intact.
